# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/generate-docs.mjs` — do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from `COMMAND_REGISTRY` + `COMMAND_DOCS` (see `core/scripts/command-registry.ts`
and `core/scripts/command-docs.ts`). Host skill command tables are fed from the same inventory.

Invoke via the host skill (`/pipeline` in Claude Code, `$pipeline` in Codex) or the
`pipeline` CLI launcher after install. Usage lines below use the neutral `pipeline` token;
substitute your host form as needed.

| Command | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `pipeline N` | Advance issue N through the pipeline (default path; up to 12 transitions) |
| `pipeline logs [<run-id>]` | List or stream pipeline run logs (terminal or structured events) |
| `pipeline status <N>` | Read-only status of issue or PR N — stage, blocker, PR, last review |
| `pipeline summary <N>` | Print the evidence bundle for issue N, or for an exact run-id |
| `pipeline cleanup` | Sweep merged-PR worktrees and delete their local branches |
| `pipeline config schema` | Config schema/validate/sync and repo-map maintenance for .github/pipeline.yml |
| `pipeline doctor` | Run deterministic preflight checks and print a pass/fail summary |
| `pipeline init` | Ensure pipeline labels and scaffold .github/pipeline.yml |
| `pipeline override <N> "<key>: <reason>"` | Disposition a review finding and auto-resume the advance loop for issue N |
| `pipeline path` | Print resolved install/engine paths for this host |
| `pipeline N --remove-worktree` | Remove issue N's on-disk worktree and local branch |
| `pipeline report` | Preview or submit a privacy-safe product-fault report (opt-in; inert when disabled) |
| `pipeline unblock <N> "<answer>"` | Post an answer and clear the blocked label for issue N |
| `pipeline backfill` | Preview or apply OpenSpec coverage for legacy behavior (spec-only PR) |
| `pipeline intake [--description "<text>"] [--release <vX.Y.Z>] [--dry-run]` | Spec a rough description into a GitHub issue and ROADMAP PR |
| `pipeline refine-spec --title "<t>" --body "<b>"` | Refine an existing issue title/body into a decision-complete spec (non-mutating JSON) |
| `pipeline roadmap` | Generate a dependency-aware scored roadmap for the backlog |
| `pipeline sweep` | Batch re-spec thin issues and reconcile ROADMAP.md |
| `pipeline triage <N> --stage ready` | Set a pre-pipeline stage label (ready or backlog) on issue N |
| `pipeline merge <pr>` | Human-only squash merge of a ready-to-deploy PR (never called by the advance loop) |
| `pipeline release <version>` | Prepare a release PR for the given version |
| `pipeline correction record …` | Record a structured correction event or attribute a control disposition |
| `pipeline improve` | Cluster recurring run friction and optionally file backlog issues |
| `pipeline loop --milestone <name>` | Start, resume, or audit a durable multi-item run (in-repo supervisor) |
| `pipeline queue` | Batch factory: dispatch pipeline:ready issues up to limits |
| `pipeline scoreboard` | Print read-only factory throughput/cost/reliability metrics from run artifacts |
| `pipeline evals plan <manifest.json>` | Manifest-driven offline experiment runner (plan/run/grade/report/harvest); never writes production GitHub |

## Commands

### `advance`

Advance issue N through the pipeline (default path; up to 12 transitions)

```text
pipeline N
pipeline N --once
pipeline N --dry-run
pipeline N --domain <d>
pipeline N --base <branch>
pipeline N --repo-path <path>
pipeline N --detach
pipeline N --doctor
```

### `logs`

List or stream pipeline run logs (terminal or structured events)

```text
pipeline:logs [<run-id>]
pipeline:logs <run-id> --follow
pipeline:logs <run-id> --events --follow
```

### `status`

Read-only status of issue or PR N — stage, blocker, PR, last review

```text
pipeline:status <N>
```

### `summary`

Print the evidence bundle for issue N, or for an exact run-id

```text
pipeline:summary <N>
pipeline:summary <run-id>
```

### `cleanup`

Sweep merged-PR worktrees and delete their local branches

```text
pipeline:cleanup
```

### `config`

Config schema/validate/sync and repo-map maintenance for .github/pipeline.yml

```text
pipeline config schema
pipeline config validate
pipeline config sync [--apply]
pipeline config repo-map <add|remove|list>
```

### `doctor`

Run deterministic preflight checks and print a pass/fail summary

```text
pipeline:doctor
pipeline:doctor --json
pipeline:doctor --is-ok
pipeline:doctor --fail-fast
```

### `init`

Ensure pipeline labels and scaffold .github/pipeline.yml

```text
pipeline:init
```

### `override`

Disposition a review finding and auto-resume the advance loop for issue N

```text
pipeline:override <N> "<key>: <reason>"
```

### `path`

Print resolved install/engine paths for this host

```text
pipeline path
pipeline path --json
```

### `remove-worktree`

Remove issue N's on-disk worktree and local branch

```text
pipeline N --remove-worktree
pipeline N --remove-worktree --force
pipeline N --remove-worktree --json
```

### `report`

Preview or submit a privacy-safe product-fault report (opt-in; inert when disabled)

```text
pipeline report
pipeline report --yes
```

### `unblock`

Post an answer and clear the blocked label for issue N

```text
pipeline:unblock <N> "<answer>"
```

### `backfill`

Preview or apply OpenSpec coverage for legacy behavior (spec-only PR)

```text
pipeline backfill
pipeline backfill --apply
pipeline backfill --apply --capability <name>
```

### `intake`

Spec a rough description into a GitHub issue and ROADMAP PR

```text
pipeline:intake [--description "<text>"] [--release <vX.Y.Z>] [--dry-run]
```

### `refine-spec`

Refine an existing issue title/body into a decision-complete spec (non-mutating JSON)

```text
pipeline refine-spec --title "<t>" --body "<b>"
pipeline refine-spec --title "<t>" --body "<b>" --json
```

### `roadmap`

Generate a dependency-aware scored roadmap for the backlog

```text
pipeline:roadmap
pipeline:roadmap --apply
pipeline:roadmap --next <N>
pipeline:roadmap --dry-run
```

### `sweep`

Batch re-spec thin issues and reconcile ROADMAP.md

```text
pipeline:sweep
pipeline:sweep --apply
pipeline:sweep --apply --repo <owner/repo>
```

### `triage`

Set a pre-pipeline stage label (ready or backlog) on issue N

```text
pipeline:triage <N> --stage ready
pipeline:triage <N> --stage backlog
```

### `merge`

Human-only squash merge of a ready-to-deploy PR (never called by the advance loop)

```text
pipeline:merge <pr>
```

### `release`

Prepare a release PR for the given version

```text
pipeline:release <version>
pipeline:release <version> --dry-run
pipeline:release <version> --edit
```

### `correction`

Record a structured correction event or attribute a control disposition

```text
pipeline correction record …
pipeline correction attribute …
```

### `improve`

Cluster recurring run friction and optionally file backlog issues

```text
pipeline improve
pipeline improve --apply
pipeline improve --top <N> --since <date> --json
```

### `loop`

Start, resume, or audit a durable multi-item run (in-repo supervisor)

```text
pipeline:loop --milestone <name>
pipeline:loop --resume <run-id>
pipeline:loop --audit
pipeline:loop --resume <run-id> --audit --follow
pipeline:loop logs [<run-id>] [--events] [-f]
```

### `queue`

Batch factory: dispatch pipeline:ready issues up to limits

```text
pipeline queue
pipeline queue --max-issues <N> --concurrency <N> --budget-dollars <N>
pipeline queue --label <label> --milestone <m> --risk <r>
```

### `scoreboard`

Print read-only factory throughput/cost/reliability metrics from run artifacts

```text
pipeline scoreboard
pipeline scoreboard --days <N> --json
pipeline scoreboard --bucket day|week
pipeline scoreboard --by <dimension>
pipeline scoreboard --html <path>
```

### `evals`

Manifest-driven offline experiment runner (plan/run/grade/report/harvest); never writes production GitHub

```text
pipeline evals plan <manifest.json>
pipeline evals run <manifest.json>
pipeline evals grade <experiment-dir>
pipeline evals report <experiment-dir> --baseline <treatment_id>
pipeline evals harvest <request.json> [--apply] [--plan-only]
```

## Notes

- Legacy alias `run` (equivalent to advance without detach) is dispatch-only and omitted here.
- Agent-only `papercut` is hidden from operator docs; see OpenSpec / improve auto-file paths.
- There is no `auto_merge` config key and the advance loop never merges; use `pipeline merge <pr>` only as a human action after `pipeline:ready-to-deploy`.
